U.S. forces exit Iraq amid Iran war. And, SCOTUS revives Trump deportation policy
articles.desc: The U.S. has withdrawn its final troops from Iraq, leaving its defense future uncertain. And, the Supreme Court has sided for now with the Trump administration on third-country deportations.

articles.title: The U.S. military withdraws from Iraq over 2 decades after its invasion
articles.desc: 23 years after the United States military invaded Iraq, sparking an insurgency and a civil war, the U.S. has withdrawn its forces, as the country still tries to combat Iranian influence.

articles.title: Retired general who led troops in Iraq warns U.S. exit may give Iran, ISIS an opening
articles.desc: Retired Lt. Gen. H.R. McMaster, who commanded U.S. troops in Iraq, says the withdrawal could strengthen Iran and leave Iraq more vulnerable to ISIS.
